units.source_text: 这年夏天，七月底肉铺比较清闲，她又回到村子，到旅馆去帮忙了。

en.t: That summer, when the butcher shop was fairly quiet at the end of July, she went back to the village again and helped out at the inn.

units.source_text: 两年前发生的那种事，如今又不由得在阿泷的心中翻滚。

en.t: What had happened two years earlier now began churning again in Otaki's heart despite herself.

units.source_text: 她真想去嘲笑一番那些妓馆的女人。

en.t: She truly wanted to go and laugh at those women from the brothels.
